prompt: A judge needs to inspect the signed photo of entry 17. At the same time, a visitor at the information desk asks to see a photo of that entry. What can staff do now?
promptZh: 評審需要查看 17 號作品的署名照片，同時有訪客在服務台想看這件作品的照片。工作人員現在可以怎麼做？

options.text: Review folder for the judge; live close-up for the visitor.
options.zh: 評審看評審資料夾內的照片；訪客看已上線的特寫。
options.whyZh: 泰莎同意將照片用於評審，且所需照片在活動資料夾；放進評審資料夾即可供評審查看。訪客只能看已公開的圖，17 號中央特寫已上線。

options.text: Event folder for the judge; live close-up for the visitor.
options.zh: 評審看活動資料夾內的照片；訪客看已上線的特寫。
options.whyZh: 公開特寫可以給訪客看，但評審無法存取活動資料夾。

options.text: Review folder for the judge; same signed photo for the visitor.
options.zh: 評審看評審資料夾內的照片；訪客看同一張署名照。
options.whyZh: 將參考照交評審沒問題，但評審授權不包括在服務台展示這張圖。

options.text: Wait for judging permission; show the visitor the live close-up.
options.zh: 等候評審授權；訪客先看已上線的特寫。
options.whyZh: 不需要等新授權，收件紀錄已確認泰莎准許評審照片。

explanationZh: 泰莎同意將照片用於評審，且所需照片在活動資料夾；放進評審資料夾即可供評審查看。訪客只能看已公開的圖，17 號中央特寫已上線。
evidence: Judges may see approved signed photos in the private review folder. Desk visitors may see live gallery images, not judging photos. / Both makers approved judging photos. The signed photo of 17 is in the event folder, which judges cannot access. / The center close-up of 17 is live.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Judges may see approved signed photos in the private review folder. Desk visitors may see live gallery images, not judging photos.
Both makers approved judging photos. The signed photo of 17 is in the event folder, which judges cannot access.
The center close-up of 17 is live.

vocabulary.note: 此處指供評審核對作品細節的照片。
